title: Alone in Eden

sections.label: Verse 1
lines: Dust was all I was, and then
A breath that wasn't mine came in
I opened eyes I'd never used
On light that had no word yet
Cool grass underneath my feet
The first wind moving over me
And Someone kneeling close enough
That His was the first face I met

sections.label: Verse 2
lines: He walked with me in the cool of day
Taught my hands to tend and stay
To dress the ground and keep the trees
And what was mine to leave alone

sections.label: Verse 3
lines: Then He brought them, one by one
The lion gold against the sun
The heron and the fox, the deer
All waiting on a word from me
I gave each one a name to wear
And every one walked off a pair
Two by two into the green
And none of them looked back at me

sections.label: Pre-Chorus
lines: And I had no word for it
The quiet where a voice should fit

sections.label: Chorus
lines: It is not good for the man to be alone
You said it before I knew
All this wonder, and no one to show
It is not good, it is not good
For the man to be alone

sections.label: Bridge
lines: So lay me down, I trust Your hands
A deeper sleep than I have known
Take what You must from near my heart
And build what I cannot name

sections.label: Chorus
lines: It is not good for the man to be alone
You knew it before I knew
All this wonder, and no one to show
It is not good, it is not good
(mm) For the man to be alone

sections.label: Outro
lines: I woke, and You were bringing her
Across the grass, through morning light
And every name I'd ever made
Fell quiet at the sight
It is now very good
Now I'm not alone

epigraph: And the LORD God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him
